condition.description: A CEL expression that is true or false. The first match whose condition holds decides; a match without one always does. Facts and functions: https://github.com/lustefaniak/prbar/blob/main/docs/rules.md#reference-facts

output.description: What this rule decides, as YAML fields, or as a quoted CEL expression for an output that has to be computed.

oneOf.description: A CEL map with the same fields, for an output that has to be computed: '{"rule": "x", "action": <a CEL expression>}'.

rule.description: Rules that apply only when this match's condition holds; when none of them matches, evaluation goes on after this match.

agent_environment.description: Extra environment variables for the reviewing agent, added to the default ones; a `!NAME` key drops one.

ai_review_enabled.description: Whether PRBar reviews this repository's PRs at all.

auto_approve.description: When PRBar approves on its own. Replaces the default block as a whole: a field left out takes its shipped value, not the default block's.

allow_approve_with_notes.description: Approve a review whose verdict is 'comment' too.

claude_min_confidence.description: The floor for claude's reviews, when it differs.

codex_min_confidence.description: The floor for codex's reviews, when it differs.

enabled.description: Approve on its own when every gate below passes.

max_additions.description: At most this many added lines; 0 for no cap. Default 200.

max_annotation_severity.description: No finding may be worse than this. Default suggestion.

max_annotations.description: At most this many findings; 0 for no cap.

max_changed_files.description: At most this many changed files; 0 for no cap.

max_deletions.description: At most this many deleted lines; 0 for no cap.

min_confidence.description: The review's confidence must be at least this. Default 0.85.

post_attribution_comment.description: Approve with a one-line body naming PRBar.

post_inline_annotations.description: Post the findings inline with the approval.

auto_deny.description: When PRBar pushes back on its own. Replaces the default block as a whole.

action.description: What a pushback posts: nothing, a flag in PRBar, a comment, or a request for changes.

claude_min_confidence.description: The floor for claude's reviews, when it differs.

codex_min_confidence.description: The floor for codex's reviews, when it differs.

max_additions.description: Only PRs with at most this many added lines; 0 for no cap.

min_confidence.description: The review's confidence must be at least this. Default 0.85.

min_matching_annotations.description: At least this many such findings. Default 1.

post_inline_annotations.description: Post the findings inline with it. Default on.

required_severity.description: Findings counted are at least this bad. Default warning.

churn_history_depth.description: How many commits of history the risk brief reads.

churn_window_days.description: How far back the risk brief counts a file's recent changes.

claude_effort.description: claude's --effort: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

claude_model.description: claude's --model, such as sonnet or opus.

codex_effort.description: codex's reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high or xhigh.

collapse_above_subreview_count.description: More subreviews than this become one review of the whole PR; 0 turns that off.

custom_system_prompt.description: Added to the review prompt; an empty string for none.

exclude_title_patterns.description: PRs whose title matches are not reviewed. Added to the default patterns; `!pattern` drops one.

force_full_review.description: Review the whole PR again on every push, rather than what changed since the last review.

max_cost_usd_per_subreview.description: A review that would cost more is stopped.

max_parallel_subreviews.description: Subreviews of one PR run at most this many at a time.

max_tool_calls_per_subreview.description: A soft cap on the agent's tool calls in one review.

min_files_per_subreview.description: Fewer changed files than this in a subfolder fold it into the root review.

notify_policy.description: When PRBar tells you a PR is ready for you: as each is ready, or once the inbox settles.

provider.description: The agent that reviews: claude or codex.

replace_base_system_prompt.description: Use custom_system_prompt instead of PRBar's prompt, not beside it.

resolve_threads.description: Resolve PRBar's own threads whose finding is gone and the author replied to.

enabled.description: Resolve threads PRBar opened once their finding is gone.

min_confidence.description: Only after a review at least this confident. Default 0.85.

review_timeout_seconds.description: A review running longer is stopped.

risk_brief_enabled.description: Give the review a reading order of the riskiest files.

rule.description: The rule's id, shown in `rules explain` with the settings it set.

share_findings.description: When neither gate fires, post the findings at or above this level as a comment review with no verdict.

share_max_comments.description: At most this many inline comments in one share, worst first.

share_min_confidence.description: Findings are shared only from a review at least this confident.

skip_ai_if_reviewed_by_others.description: Don't review a PR someone else already approved or requested changes on.

skip_merge_confirmation.description: Merge from PRBar without asking first.

split_mode.description: One review for the whole PR, or one per subfolder that matches root_patterns. perSubfolder: One review per subfolder that matches root_patterns. single: One review of the whole diff.

tool_mode.description: What the reviewing agent may use: a sandboxed checkout, read-only tools, or none.

unmatched_strategy.description: What happens to changes outside every root pattern.

match.description: Tried top to bottom; the first whose condition holds decides.

variables.description: Named sub-expressions, read in conditions as variables.<name>.

description: A policy in rules/configure/: how a repository's pull requests are reviewed. Conditions read `repo` (owner, name, full_name) and `lists`. Each file's first match applies, files in name order, a later file's fields replacing an earlier one's; what no rule sets comes from the review defaults in prbar.yaml. Guide: https://github.com/lustefaniak/prbar/blob/main/docs/rules.md
title: PRBar configure rules
